existing.description: The ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship gives refugees living in Australia three sessions of English language study to overcome the language barrier that stops newly arrived refugees from entering tertiary education or employment. It covers 11 to 12 weeks of English tuition in groups, all learning materials and resources, and administrative fees, plus free Duolingo Premium for the placement. Two scholarships per campus are available every three sessions, and applications are open year-round.
eligibility: Hold, or be on a bridging visa for, one of the Australian humanitarian visa subclasses 200, 201, 202, 203, 204, 785, 790, 851 or 866
Be at least 18 years of age at the commencement of studies
Live within commuting distance of the ILSC-Adelaide, ILSC-Brisbane, ILSC-Melbourne, ILSC-Sydney or ILSC-Perth campus
Not have received a Centrelink Relocation Grant
Not have received the ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship before
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to refugees aged 18 or over at the commencement of study who hold or are on a bridging visa for one of the Australian humanitarian visa subclasses 200, 201, 202, 203, 204, 785, 790, 851 or 866, and who live within commuting distance of an ILSC campus in Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne, Sydney or Perth. Applicants who have received a Centrelink Relocation Grant are not eligible.
benefits: Three sessions of English language study, structured as four-week sessions except in December
Free Duolingo Premium for the duration of the placement, sponsored by Duolingo
Access to free events and clubs on campus
Barista skills development through the Cafe Work Skills course
Access to other selective courses matched to the applicant's interests
coverage: 11 to 12 weeks of English language study in groups
General English, Exam Preparation and English for Academic Purposes components
All learning materials and resources required for the classes
Free Duolingo Premium account for the duration of the placement
requirements: Must be able to provide proof of an Australian humanitarian visa or the relevant bridging visa
Must complete the free ILSC Online English Placement Test, and must reach at least Pre-intermediate
Must not have received a Centrelink Relocation Grant
Must not have received the ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship previously
Must maintain a minimum attendance of 80 per cent during the programme
Must accept the scholarship offer within 48 hours, or it is withdrawn and offered to another candidate
Course selections and timetables are subject to availability on enrolment, and confirmed start dates cannot be deferred
documents: Proof of Australian humanitarian visa or the relevant bridging visa
Completed free ILSC Online English Placement Test result, showing at least Pre-intermediate
existing.english_requirement: Applicants must complete the free ILSC Online English Placement Test and score at least Pre-intermediate to be eligible. The award itself is an English language programme, so no higher English standard is required.
application_method: Apply online through the ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship application page
Complete the Online English Placement Test using the link sent by ILSC, before the deadline stated in the email
Wait for selection by the committee of staff and teachers at the ILSC Australia schools
Accept the offer within 48 hours of receiving it to secure the place
existing.selection_notes: Scholarship candidates are selected by a committee of staff and teachers at the ILSC Australia schools. Successful candidates are offered the scholarship based on the earliest available date. ILSC states it does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, national origin, disability, age, gender, sexual orientation or religion.
existing.best_fit: A newly arrived refugee in Australia, aged 18 or over, on a humanitarian or bridging visa, living near one of ILSC's five Australian campuses.
existing.notes: No monetary value is published; the award covers tuition, materials and administrative fees. One session lasts four weeks except in December. ILSC Australia is CRICOS provider 02137M, RTO 31564.
existing.duration: Three sessions, with one session lasting four weeks except in December
existing.application_period: Applications are open year-round. Applicants receive a link to complete ILSC's Online English Placement Test, which must be completed by the deadline stated in that email, and successful candidates are offered the earliest available date.
existing.deadline_display: Rolling intake - applications are open year-round and no closing date is published
existing.program_type: Private education provider scholarship (refugees and asylum seekers on Australian humanitarian visas)
